extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from primary paper figures/text.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: SM-985 increases bacterial membrane permeability in both Gram-positive and Gram-negative indicators.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Evidence supports membrane permeabilization under the tested assay conditions, not a fully resolved pore structure.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: FITC-SM-985 localizes to bacterial membranes and retains cell-killing activity in representative Gram-positive and Gram-negative indicators.
mechanism_claims.limitations: FITC-tagged peptide evidence is used for localization/cell-killing support and is not substituted for unlabeled MIC/MBC values.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: SEM/TEM imaging supports physical membrane and envelope damage after SM-985 treatment of C. michiganesis ssp. michiganesis.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: SM-985 against C. michiganesis ssp. michiganesis
mechanism_claims.limitations: Imaging is shown for one representative bacterial indicator.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Calcium chloride reduces SM-985 antibacterial activity in the tested C. michiganesis and P. syringae assays.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The source supports a salt-sensitivity phenotype; the molecular explanation remains interpretive.
